Sigrika who had come to seek counseling from Luuk Herssen, brushes past you as she leaves to find her friend Nivora resting in the infirmary. You have come to the infirmary to discuss the Exostrider plan with Luuk. Frustrated, you refuse the candy he offers and voice your distrust about how much he knows. Luuk smiles, unperturbed, and invites you to a more private location to talk. Luuk reveals that his presence in Lahai-Roi was arranged by your past self, a move connected to the Fractsidus. Luuk explains that his father's identity was also stolen by the Fractsidus's Grand Architect. ;Hatred was his initial motivation for pursuing the organization, and the very reason your past self chose him for this task. In a secret workspace, Luuk introduces you to the wealth of intelligence he gathered while infiltrating the Fractsidus. His apparent indifference to his own life or death raises your suspicion. He promises to speak with Lucilla to smoothly advance your plans with the Exostrider, which entails you piloting it beyond the Stridergate to retrieve Aemeath. In the past, Luuk once teetered on the edge of darkness, holding the Grand Architect's pen amidst burning flames. Your past self called him to Lahai-Roi, preventing his fall and ensuring he did not become the very enemy he hunted. Luuk contacts Lucilla, and they arrange a meeting at the Research Institute. Luuk convinces Lucilla to let Rover try to pilot the Exostrider once it awakens, while she handles the board. Midway through their talk, an urgent call comes from N.A.N.A. at the infirmary informing Luuk that the detained Warren has kidnapped Nivora and is heading for the SkyArk Space Station. Luuk prepares to go, securing Lucilla's permission to scout the interior alone first. Nivora lies unconscious on the ground. Warren, desperate and on the brink of madness, lunges at Luuk. After rescuing the unconscious Nivora, she claims Warren coerced her into guiding him to the station. Luuk comforts the shaken girl and begins checking Warren's condition. Nivora trembles as she stands, then begins to approach Luuk from behind. Nivora, the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus in disguise, openly confesses "she" revealed herself early to reclaim an old pen. In a mocking acknowledgment of Luuk's efforts, "she" casually informs you that another Fractsidus member hides among the students during the upcoming New Solar Celebration, and that what Luuk seeks is in the station's data room.\nThis entire SkyArk incident was "her" setup, and she hints at knowing the truth of your origin. In the next moment, "she" vanishes. Luuk's contact with you on his way to the space station made this joint strike against the Grand Architect possible. For now, he believes you lack the means to truly eliminate this "thousand-faced individual," and that gathering more intelligence is the current priority. Inside the data room, you learn the Grand Architect once worked at the SkyArk Station, promoting the Court of Savantae's research on the Etheric Sea—she showed intense interest in it. Connecting the Etheric Sea's link to you and its potential as a gateway, you begin to form theories. Then Luuk reveals his suspicion that the Grand Architect was the one who sabotaged the Stridergate seal, triggering the Threnodian's breach. To save Lahai-Roi, Aemeath Overclocked, forcing a resonance with the Exostrider to stop it. Fresh, burning fury consumes you. Seeing this, Luuk sighs and quietly invites you outside to walk. Luuk Herssen talks about you, about candy, and about his own past. He says that no matter how strong you are, some things lie beyond anyone's control. But if you let sorrow and rage consume you, you'll lose even the memory of how it feels to be happy with someone again. As you walk with Luuk in the snow, you feel your resolve harden once more. You finally understand the kindness and solace held within a simple piece of candy. This time, you accept the one he offers.}} ==Steps== # Head to the infirmary # Greet Nivora # Head to the place Luuk Herssen mentioned # Defeat the enemies # Enter the secret workspace # Talk to Luuk Herssen # Inspect the container on the table # Head to the study # Investigate the study # Open the hidden door # Head to the farthest room # Meet Lucilla at your usual spot # Talk to student # Talk to the Senior Doctor # Continue onward # Enter the SkyArk Space Station # Continue onward and gather intel # Defeat the enemies in your way # Continue in the pursuit of Warren # Pursue Warren # Defeat the ambushing enemies # Take the module adapter and continue in pursuit # Pursue Warren # Find a way to enter the data room # Investigate the surveillance system # Examine the route ## Clear the first Error Module ## Clear the second Error Module ## Clear the third Error Module # Head to the large data room # Move through the caos # Head to the large data room # Defeat the enemies summoned by Warren # Head deeper into the data room # Continue onward through the blizzard ==Gameplay== * Completing the quest awards the [[Rover's Journey III]] Trophy [[Taste of Sweetness]] ==Dialogue== {{Quest Description|To reach your goal, you delve deeper into the Exostrider plan, all the while, anomalies hidden in the frostlands reveal themselves.}} {{Dialogue Start}} ;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Return to Startorch Academy :{{A|Vo main rglc 1 1 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main rglc 1 1 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (Luuk texted me to go over the Exostrider plan at the infirmary.
